name: Corporations and Other Entities: All Filings
attribution: New York State Department of State
description: This data contains all Corporations and Other Entity filings in the Department of State electronic database. Each record contains the Department of State ID number, Filing ID, Date Filed, Effective Date, Entity Name, the law under which the filing was made and other pertinent filing information.

columns.name: DOS ID Number
columns.description: DOS Unique ID number for each entity

columns.name: Filing Num
columns.description: Unique ID Number for each document filed

columns.name: Date Filed
columns.description: The date the document was filed by Department of State

columns.name: Approved Date
columns.description: Date the document was approved by the Department of State for filing

columns.name: Eff Date
columns.description: Effective Date of the document filed

columns.name: Duration Date
columns.description: The date on which a corporation is dissolved by expiration of its period of duration or the date after which the Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership is to dissolve

columns.name: Dis Eff Date
columns.description: Date on which a dissolution becomes effective

columns.name: Foreign Formation Date
columns.description: Date on which a foreign entity was formed in the jurisdiction of its formation

columns.name: Mod Cert Code
columns.description: The mod cert code, taken together with the information in the LAW field, is a description of the type of document represented by this record

columns.name: Entity Type
columns.description: Type of entity (e.g., “business corporation”)

columns.name: Cnty Prin Ofc
columns.description: County in which the office or principal office of the entity is to be located

columns.name: Jurisdiction
columns.description: State or country of formation

columns.name: Admin Name Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicated that during a previous data conversion this filing has the correct name of the entity.  This flag does not affect the current name of the entity.

columns.name: Amd Cnty Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change in County.

columns.name: Amd Name Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change in the Entity Name

columns.name: Amd Dura Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change in Corporation’s duration date or the latest date of dissolution for a Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership

columns.name: Amd Fict Name Flag
columns.description: Fictitious name indicator for the filing.  '1' means maintain the fictitious name, '2' means the fictitious name was amended or changed, '3' means the fictitious name is being dropped or deactivated, '4' means a fictitious name was added to the entity

columns.name: Amd Foreign formation Date Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change to the formation date of a foreign entity.  This is the date when a foreign entity was formed in the jurisdiction of its formation

columns.name: Amd For Juris Flag
columns.description: ‘X' indicates a change to the foreign entity’s jurisdiction of formation

columns.name: Amd NFP Category Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change to the Not-For-Profit Corporation category

columns.name: Amd SOP Address Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change to the Service of Process address

columns.name: Amd Prov. Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change to a provision in the document indicated. This is a catch-all for amendments or changes not covered by other amendment flags

columns.name: Amd Purps. Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates an amendment to the Purpose of an entity

columns.name: Amd Reg Agt Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change in the Registered Agent’s address

columns.name: Amd Share Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates a change in the Share information

columns.name: Amd Loc. Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates change to the Business Corporation’s principal executive office

columns.name: Amd Admit Prtnr Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates the addition of a general partner to a limited partnership

columns.name: Amd Withdr Prtnr Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates the withdraw of a general partner from a limited partnership

columns.name: Restate Cert Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates the filing is a Restated Certificate of Incorporation

columns.name: Amd Chair Flag
columns.description: 'X' indicates the addition or amendment to the Name and/or business address of the Chief Executive Office

columns.name: Card File Flag
columns.description: Indicates the Corporations and Other Business Entity Database does not include the entire filing record history for the entity.  'F' means the document is the first record in the filing history and that other prior document(s) are not on file with DOS.  'D' means that only part of the filing history is in the Database and that the DOS Card Index includes information on other documents filed with DOS

columns.name: Constituent Flag
columns.description: A 'C' indicates that the entity is a constituent of a merger or consolidation and that additional information for the constituent is not in the Database, is not available, or is maintained in the DOS Card File
